rfp_summary: The client is seeking a partner to migrate workloads to cloud and provide managed operations.
solution_summary: Phased migration with managed SOC and cloud operations.

proposal_sections.executive_summary: We propose a phased cloud migration program for Acme Health that modernizes infrastructure, reduces operational risk, and establishes a compliant managed-services operating model.
proposal_sections.technical_approach: Our team will assess current workloads, prioritize migration waves, implement landing zones, and transition the environment into managed operations with security controls aligned to HIPAA.
proposal_sections.implementation_plan: The delivery plan includes discovery, migration factory setup, phased execution, and steady-state managed support.
proposal_sections.pricing_notes: Commercials will be finalized after discovery and workload validation.
